skill.name: amazon-product-api-skill
skill.description: Submit Amazon product searches through BrowserAct and monitor workflow status using keyword, brand, page, and language parameters.
skill.summary: Run configurable Amazon product searches through the BrowserAct workflow API.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, normal error checks, or standard bearer-token handling. The skill makes intentional BrowserAct network requests, but its instructions to provide an API key in chat create a high-risk credential exposure path.

remediation.issue: The instructions permit users to provide the BrowserAct API key in chat.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or approved secret store, and never request or repeat the key in conversation.

remediation.issue: Search terms and authentication are sent to the BrowserAct service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the external data transfer before execution and document BrowserAct data handling, retention, and access requirements.

content.value_statement: Manual Amazon product research is slow and inconsistent. This skill submits BrowserAct workflows and monitors their status for structured listing data.
actual_capabilities: Submits Amazon product searches to a fixed BrowserAct workflow template.
Accepts keyword, brand, page count, and interface language parameters.
Authenticates with BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the process environment.
Polls task status every ten seconds for up to five minutes.
Reports connection, authorization, task failure, cancellation, and timeout errors.
limitations: A BrowserAct account, API key, and service access are required.
Search parameters and bearer authentication are sent to BrowserAct.
The current script returns after polling, so its result retrieval code does not run.
The skill does not store history or calculate price changes across runs.

use_cases.title: Compare Market Listings
use_cases.description: Collect product titles, prices, ratings, and featured badges for a keyword and brand.

use_cases.title: Enrich Product Catalogs
use_cases.description: Gather ASINs, product URLs, brands, and available attributes for catalog review.

use_cases.title: Research Localized Results
use_cases.description: Run searches with different interface languages to examine localized product listings.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Product Category
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for wireless earbuds from Samsung using one page and English. Summarize titles, ASINs, prices, and ratings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Listing Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for Dell laptops across two pages in German. Compare current prices, original prices, ratings, rating counts, and featured badges.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Product Attributes
prompt_templates.prompt: Find one page of Logitech wireless mouse listings in English. Group results by material, color, and style, and identify missing attributes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate one-page searches for Apple and Samsung tablets in English. Compare median prices, rating strength, featured badges, and listing coverage.

output_examples.input: Search for Samsung wireless earbuds on one English results page.
output: Matching products are listed with title, ASIN, product URL, and brand.
Each available listing includes current price, original price, average rating, and rating count.
Featured badges and available color, material, or style details appear beside each product.

output_examples.input: Compare Dell laptop listings across two German results pages.
output_examples.output: The report groups Dell listings by price and rating, highlights featured products, and notes unavailable specifications.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an approved environment or secret-management tool.
Start with one page, then expand only when the initial query is relevant.
Record query parameters and collection time when comparing separate runs.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat, prompts, logs, or command arguments.
Do not treat current listing prices as historical price-change evidence.
Do not request many pages before confirming the keyword and brand filters.

faq.question: What credentials does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a BrowserAct API key provided through the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Does the skill call Amazon directly?
faq.answer: No. It submits a fixed Amazon product workflow to BrowserAct, which performs the browser task.

faq.question: Which search options are supported?
faq.answer: The script accepts keywords, one brand, a page count, and an interface language.

faq.question: How long can a search run?
faq.answer: The script polls every ten seconds and stops after five minutes.

faq.question: Can it track price history automatically?
faq.answer: No. It does not store prior results or calculate changes between collection times.

faq.question: Why might no product data appear?
faq.answer: The current control flow returns after polling before result retrieval. The script requires a code fix to print completed task data.
